summary: Short kerb beside a roundabout, with houses 5 m and 7 m away.
reasons: Houses 5 m and 7 m from kerb

best_section.where: West kerb of Whitmore Street just south of the roundabout

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 5 m, 7 m and 13 m; apartments 16 m away; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: A car is parked on the kerb here, so room exists, but the stretch is short.
drivers.traffic: Beside a roundabout on a through road.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the kerb; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Tree shade from the west side; otherwise open.
